resources.string: Izithombe-skrini ezivikelekile, iphakheji lomsindo, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza
I-FLAG_SECURE iyashiywa ukuze izithombe-skrini, ukurekhoda isikrini nokusakaza kusebenze kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza. Ividiyo ye-DRM ihlala imnyama.
Ithoni yokukhala, isaziso, i-alamu nemisindo yesistimu ezenzakalelayo kushintshiwe
Izinhlelo zokusebenza ziyahlanganiswa ngokuya ngamaphrofayela azo okusetshenziswa esikhundleni sokulinda iwindi lokulondoloza lapho kungasetshenziswa. Inqubekela phambili iboniswa esaziseni.
